doc: Ghost powers (features/souls/README.md): each row is one soul's power. Activation costs madness_cost on the Madness meter (pitch section 5; a stub: it rises on use, decays at madness.decay_per_s, and a power whose cost would pass madness.max is refused). A power runs duration_s, then cools down cooldown_s; only one power runs at a time. interrupt_on lists the reasons that end it early (hit, stunned, car, knocked_down). bark_on/bark_off are voice line ids (audio lands later). action is the InputMap action in input_actions.json. hauler and gearbox hold each soul's own tuning.

gearbox.doc: Gearbox: remote-hijack a car in view. The soft lock takes the nearest car within lock_radius_m of the reticle and range_m of Rivet; the car then drives at drive_mps toward the reticle, turning at most turn_dps, and wrecks on a contact above crash_mps. Rivet stays on foot and steers (his move is scaled by rivet_move_k while steering): the cost. residue_s is the residue upgrade: when the power ends (not on a wreck), the car keeps driving its last order for residue_s, unsteered and Rivet unslowed (0 = locked: the car stops on release).

hauler.doc: Hauler: Rivet becomes the bulky ghost tank (body class body_class, bodies.json). morph_s is the readable grow/shrink; the tank moves at most top_mps, accelerates at accel_mps2 (momentum: no instant stop) and turns at most turn_dps. Ram: above ram_mps a contact knocks down humans and robots (the tackle matrix) and damages a car by ram_car_damage. Stomp: arm() starts a stomp_windup_s telegraph (readable, dodgeable), then a radial shockwave of stomp_radius_m, knockdown inside stomp_knock_m, stun stomp_stun_s, every stomp_cooldown_s. look is the tank silhouette (ASK ghost-powers-2): scaled = Rivet's parts grown to the hauler FORMS size; bulked = the same plus arms shortened to look_arm_k (a squat press-bot); both tint toward the souls' teal by look_tint_k. The stomp lands with camera.json shake stomp_shake and hit-stop stomp_hitstop; each ram hit lands with ram_shake and ram_hitstop (ids in that table; the hit-stop cooldown keeps a burst to one stop). Sound hooks: morph_cue as the morph starts, stomp_cue as the stomp lands (audio_cues.json ids, temp picks until a stomp sound exists). On quest 1's stage and the arena (HaulerStage): the stomp deals stomp_damage to every live fighter in its radius and throws it by the knockback; a ram deals ram_damage to a fighter it touches (a human guard has 1 hp).
